text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text: O... Oooooh...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Un... believable, Mejiro Ramonu...! To run 
like this in her debut race...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Wait, look. Just now... Mejiro Ramonu...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...From now on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It's okay to love you... even more, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I can let it all out now, can't I? 
Everything I've kept dammed up inside..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: “How... wonderful...――”

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text: Lady... Mejiro Ramonu... How radiant...

Hard to believe she just finished a 
grueling race, with a smile that looks as 
if she's in love—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And so, I shall ask what I wish to know 
most~.
choice_data_list: （本当に、レースが好きなんだなぁ）

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is true. It is something found within 
your heart, Trainer~.

—I wanted to know more about Mejiro 
Ramonu. Because I felt that I didn't truly 
understand her.

And yet, I already knew the one thing I 
most wanted to know... No, the one thing I 
needed to know as a Trainer.

"Simply because I love racing." If that's 
the case, then charge ahead without 
hesitation. Toward that shining goal—
choice_data_list: （ラモーヌはなぜ、レースを走るのか）

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Target Race.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's make up our minds.

text_block_list.text:
The main goal for the Classic year is the 
Tiara route... To win the Oka Sho, the 
Japanese Oaks, and the Shuka Sho, 
achieving the Triple Tiara.

I want to make a statement for the future 
in a big Junior Class race... a GⅠ. One 
where many Umamusume aspiring for the 
Tiara route compete—
choice_data_list: その前に、走ってほしいレースがある！
choice_data_list_en: Before that, there's a race I want you to run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hmm...
choice_data_list: 『阪神ジュベナイルフィリーズ』はどうだ？
『阪神ジュベナイルフィリーズ』はどう？
choice_data_list_en: How about the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies?
How about the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Heh... Passionate, aren't you?
choice_data_list: ここからクラシック級の道を拓いていこう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's blaze a trail to the Classic tier from here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Very well. That sounds delightful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: A GⅠ— What an enchanting ring to it.

Speaking of GⅠs, they are high-class races 
that only Umamusume with proven ability 
can enter. Truly the centerpiece of 
racing, aimed for by all and watched by 
all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I do not mind.

Though I got a little ahead of myself, our 
next goal before taking on the Triple 
Tiara has been set: the Hanshin JF!
